stem:
Read the list and answer the question that follows.

• Japan invades Korea and China.
• Germany invades Poland.
• Japan attacks Pearl Harbor.

Which title correctly replaces the question mark?

options.label: A
options.text: Events That Encouraged the United States to Join NATO

options.label: B
options.text: Events That Inspired U.S. Nationalism during World War I

options.label: C
options.text: Events That Contributed to U.S. Rejection of the League of Nations

options.label: D
options.text: Events That Led to U.S. Involvement in World War II

question mark as placeholder for title
